name: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Engine & Turbocharger (MHIET) / Mitsubishi Generator Series (MGS)
legal_name: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Engine & Turbocharger, Ltd. (100% owned by Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Ltd.)
brands: Mitsubishi Generator Series (MGS): MGS-B, MGS-R, MGS-HV, MGS-DC, MGS-G, MU-G
Mitsubishi S-series diesel engines (S6R, S12R, S16R, S16R2)
employees: 5,500 consolidated (MHIET company overview, organisation as of 1 April 2026)
revenue: Not published separately; capital 5,000 million yen. MHIET is a wholly owned MHI subsidiary.
sector: Diesel and gas engines, MGS generator sets 480 kVA to 2,750 kVA high speed and up to 4,500 kVA medium speed, turbochargers, power systems engineering
positioning_text: MHIET is the MHI engine subsidiary behind the Mitsubishi Generator Series. MGS sets use MHIET's own S-series engines (S12R, S16R, S16R2) at 1500 or 1800 rpm and are assembled by MHI Engine System Asia in Singapore, Vietnam and, since 2025, Johor Bahru, with a dedicated MGS-DC rating table for data centres. The Middle East is run from MHI Engine System Middle East FZE in Sharjah (est. 2010), which holds a parts depot and sells through Saudi Diesel Equipment Co. in Al Khobar, Precision Integrated Power Solutions in Abu Dhabi and Al-Sultan & Khalaf in Kuwait. Mitsubishi Power's Dammam gas turbine assembly and Saudi Aramco and SEC relationships give the wider group a localisation story in KSA that the genset business does not yet have.

movements.headline: MHIET launches MGS3100R, a 3,000 kVA class set with common rail S16R2 engine
movements.summary: MGS3100R rated 3,025 kVA standby / critical power and 2,750 kVA prime / data centre continuous at 50 Hz, 6,785 x 2,820 x 3,170 mm, 23,100 kg dry, ISO 8528-5 G3 and NFPA 110, assembled in Singapore and Vietnam for factories, hospitals and data centres in Asia Pacific. MHIET stated MGS had sold over 12,000 units to date.

relevance.analysis: This is Mitsubishi's answer to the 2.5 MW to 3 MW data centre node that Cummins serves with QSK78 and QSK95 based sets. It is not yet on the Middle East catalogue, which caps Mitsubishi's Gulf offer at 2,750 kVA until MHIES-ME adopts MGS-R. Cummins Arabia should keep quoting above 2.75 MVA where Mitsubishi cannot follow locally.

movements.headline: MHI-ESA adds MGS assembly plant in Johor Bahru, Malaysia with WDG Assembly
movements.summary: New production hub for MGS units to meet rising data centre and critical infrastructure demand in Southeast Asia, alongside Singapore and Vietnam assembly.

relevance.analysis: Extra MGS capacity in Asia shortens lead times for Gulf orders that ship from Singapore. Cummins Arabia should expect Mitsubishi dealers in KSA and UAE to quote firmer delivery on 1.5 MVA to 2.75 MVA sets.

movements.headline: MHIET launches 450 kW gas cogeneration system capable of hydrogen co-firing
movements.summary: Reliability verified through demonstration testing; part of MHIET's low carbon gas engine roadmap.

relevance.analysis: Small gas CHP is a Japan-first product. Gulf relevance is limited today but it signals Mitsubishi will pitch hydrogen-ready gas engines into Saudi and UAE decarbonisation programmes where Cummins gas gensets also compete.

movements.headline: MHI-ESA launches containerised MGS2500R for data centres
movements.summary: Up to 2,500 kVA standby in a 40 ft high cube container, Critical Power and Data Center Continuous Power duty, Tier III and Tier IV compliant, launched at Data Centre World Asia 2025 in Singapore with an APAC 50 Hz focus.

relevance.analysis: A plug-in containerised 2.5 MVA set is the format UAE and Kuwait colocation builders ask for. Cummins Arabia should have a matching containerised C2500 or C2750 offer priced and documented for 50 Hz markets before Mitsubishi dealers bring this to Dubai.

movements.headline: Mitsubishi Power unveils first locally assembled M501JAC gas turbine at Dammam, marking 60 years in Saudi Arabia
movements.summary: The Dammam facility assembled its first JAC turbine, destined for the 475 MW Amiral cogeneration plant in Jubail (TAQA and JERA) serving SATORP. Mitsubishi Power reports over 50% Saudisation and partnerships with Saudi Aramco, SEC and SWCC.

relevance.analysis: Mitsubishi Power's Saudi localisation is in gas turbines, not gensets, but it gives the Mitsubishi name Vision 2030 credibility with Aramco, SEC and the Eastern Province. If MHIET ever routes MGS assembly or service through Dammam, that would be a direct challenge. Cummins Arabia should keep its own Saudi localisation and IKTVA content visible to the same buyers.

movements.headline: MHI-ESA terminates Indonesia dealership for MGS-G gas generator sets
movements.summary: Formal termination notice for the MGS-G dealership arrangement in Indonesia.

relevance.analysis: Shows Mitsubishi actively manages its gas genset channel. In the Middle East MGS-G is sold direct by MHIES-ME with no local dealer, so gas genset coverage in KSA, UAE and Kuwait is thin. Cummins Arabia's gas offer faces little Mitsubishi channel pressure.

movements.headline: MHI-ESA hosts MGS Sales and Service Maintenance Conference 2026 for Asia Pacific dealers in Bali
movements.summary: Dealer network conference under the theme 'Preserving Excellence. Engineered, Not Accidental'; Diamond Dealer awards to Malaysian, Indonesian and Hong Kong dealers. Middle East dealers were not referenced.

relevance.analysis: Mitsubishi's dealer development effort is centred on Asia Pacific; the Middle East network is small (one dealer per Gulf country) and run from Sharjah. Cummins Arabia's branch depth in KSA, UAE and Kuwait is a clear service argument against MGS in tenders that score after-sales coverage.

movements.headline: MHI-ESA headline partner at DCD Connect APAC 2026, pitching MGS-R and grid-to-chip resilience
movements.summary: MHI-ESA presented MGS-R innovations and one-stop data centre solutions for AI and HPC workloads in Bali.

relevance.analysis: Mitsubishi is marketing MGS as an AI data centre product in Asia. The same hyperscale and colocation operators build in KSA and UAE. Cummins Arabia should track which APAC operators standardise on MGS and prepare Gulf-specific counters.

movements.headline: MHIET 500 kW class 100% hydrogen engine generator set reaches commercial readiness level
movements.summary: 435 kWe at 1,500 rpm from a 6-cylinder 170 mm bore engine on pure hydrogen, tested at Sagamihara with green hydrogen; only long-term durability evaluation remains.

relevance.analysis: Relevant to NEOM and UAE hydrogen showcase projects where zero carbon backup power will be specified. Cummins Arabia should be ready to discuss Cummins hydrogen engine roadmap when consultants raise this.

movements.headline: Mitsubishi Power wins boiler supply for heavy oil to gas fuel conversion at Jeddah South and Shuqaiq plants
movements.summary: Contract from Saudi Energy for dual fuel conversion of four units at each of two 2.9 GW west coast plants, with Dar Al Balad as local EPC and Mitsubishi Corporation Machinery as agent.

relevance.analysis: Context only: it deepens Mitsubishi's standing with Saudi utility buyers and local EPCs. No genset scope. Cummins Arabia should note that Dar Al Balad and similar EPCs now have a working Mitsubishi relationship that could extend to backup power packages.

movements.headline: MHIET sets hydrogen co-firing specifications for KU series gas engines (3.65 to 5.75 MW)
movements.summary: Up to 50% hydrogen by volume on 18KU30SI class engines for cogeneration, grid stability and power wheeling, available for new units and retrofits with minimal design change.

relevance.analysis: KU series competes with Cummins HSK78G and larger gas engines in industrial CHP and grid support. Gulf gas engine demand from data centres and utilities is growing and Mitsubishi now has a hydrogen-ready spec to offer. Cummins Arabia should sharpen its own fuel flexibility story.

partnerships.scope: Sales and service of MGS industrial generator sets; SDEC packages its own SDE gensets and markets MGS-R compact and large ranges from 568 kVA to 2,500 kVA; offices in Al Khobar (HQ), Riyadh, Jeddah, Yanbu, Madinah, Abha and a Dammam 2nd Industrial City factory

why_it_matters.analysis: SDEC is an established Saudi packager with an Eastern Province factory and nationwide offices, so MGS in KSA comes with a credible local assembly and service story. It also carries other engine brands, so its loyalty to Mitsubishi is commercial rather than exclusive. Cummins Arabia should watch SDEC in Aramco and industrial 60 Hz tenders and use its own Saudi branch coverage and parts stock to compete.

partnerships.scope: Sales and service of MGS industrial generator sets in the UAE from Abu Dhabi

why_it_matters.analysis: Single-location UAE dealer without published Dubai presence. Cummins Arabia's UAE service footprint is stronger; press that in Abu Dhabi government and oil and gas bids where PIPS is active.

partnerships.scope: Sole Kuwait dealer for Mitsubishi diesel generators 500 kVA to 3,000 kVA; also sells Perkins-powered and Baifa sets; 800 square metre generator workshop with load banks in Shuwaikh

why_it_matters.analysis: Multi-brand dealer with ministry project history in Kuwait. It will position MGS on price against Cummins in MEW and government tenders. Cummins Arabia should hold specification advantages (paralleling, data centre ratings, emissions) in the tender text.

partnerships.partner: MHI Engine System Asia (Singapore) and MHI Engine System Vietnam
partnerships.scope: MGS assembly plants supplying the Middle East; Johor Bahru added 2025

why_it_matters.analysis: All Gulf MGS supply is imported from Asia; there is no Middle East assembly. Cummins Arabia can use local assembly, stock and Saudi content as a differentiator.

partnerships.scope: Mitsubishi S16R and S16R2 engines packaged by Rehlko in T2200C and T2500-E sets sold in EMEA

why_it_matters.analysis: Mitsubishi engines reach the Gulf through two channels, MGS dealers and Rehlko distributors. That doubles the number of bids carrying S16R engines against Cummins QSK60 based sets in the 2 MVA to 2.5 MVA band.

partnerships.partner: Saudi Aramco, Saudi Electricity Company, SWCC, TAQA and JERA (Mitsubishi Power)
partnerships.scope: Gas turbine, boiler and cogeneration supply and service; first locally assembled M501JAC at Dammam in 2025 for the Amiral cogeneration plant

why_it_matters.analysis: These relationships belong to Mitsubishi Power, not MHIET, but they give the Mitsubishi brand standing with the same Saudi buyers who specify backup gensets for utility and industrial sites.
